purpose: Teach: たどり着い/サス/塀/乗用車/新生/捕らえ/クライマックス/盛りだくさん

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新店、ようやく、夢、たどり着いた感じやな、本当に、よかったやんか、葵さん、応援してて、ええで。
lines.en: Aoi — the new store, you finally made it happen. I'm really proud of you. Keep it up.
lines.style: Warm, genuine Kansai energy. Leans forward with enthusiasm. Open-chested delivery on the opening name. Lands the compliment with natural sincerity, not performing support.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。サスペンスドラマで、紹介された料理、ぜひ、メニューに、入れたいです、葵で、お客様、喜びそうですね。
lines.en: Yes. There's a dish from that mystery drama I've been wanting to add to the menu — I think our customers will really love having something that special.
lines.style: Thoughtful and engaged. Looks up from planning. Speaks with quiet conviction about the dish, then trails slightly on the menu vision — still working it out aloud.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店の塀、ガーデニング風に、整えよか、葵さん、お洒落で、ええんちゃうか、ここの、雰囲気、合うで、絶対。
lines.en: You should fix up that wall out front with some garden-style landscaping. Something stylish like that would fit perfectly with the whole feel of the place.
lines.style: Energized, gesturing as he talks. Kansai cadence lands on the design idea. Sees it clearly and sells it without being pushy — offering, not ordering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。配送用の乗用車、新しいの、検討、進めましょう、葵で、業務効率化、必要ですね、本当に、最近。
lines.en: Right. And we should start looking into a new delivery van — something more efficient for the business side of things. It's becoming more important lately.
lines.style: Practical and forward-thinking. Shifts slightly to logistics mode but keeps warmth. Voice settles into business mindset without losing the collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新生のスタッフ、若い人材、本気で、育てていこか、葵さん、料理人、伸ばすの、楽しみやで、本当に。
lines.en: Let's really invest in training the new staff — the younger people coming in. I'm genuinely excited to watch the cooks grow here.
lines.style: Earnest and present. Kansai warmth in the delivery. Slight pause before 'grow' — genuine feeling underneath the excitement. Not performative, real investment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。料理の盛り付け、お客様の、心を、捕らえる工夫、必要ですよね、葵で、常に、研究、しています、最近。
lines.en: Of course. The way we plate the food — that's what captures a customer's heart. I'm always researching, always thinking about how to make it better.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly inward. Quiet concentration in the voice. Speaks like she's thinking aloud, careful and precise. Small pause between phrases — each word chosen.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 食事の最後、デザートのクライマックス、ええもの、出そや、葵さん、お客様、感動するで、絶対に、本当に。
lines.en: We should make sure the dessert at the end of the course really shines — something that moves people. That final moment matters.
lines.style: Building energy again. Kansai conviction on the word 'dessert.' Sees the arc of the meal and speaks to it with real passion. Animated but not rushed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。コース料理、本当に、盛りだくさんに、しましょう、葵で、お客様、満足してくださること、第一です、本当に。
lines.en: Absolutely. The whole course menu should be generous and satisfying — that's what comes first for me. Making sure our customers leave happy.
lines.style: Warm, settled resolve. Slower pace here — this is the closing statement. Speaks from the centre of what matters to her. Genuine, without softness.
